note: Re-judged 2026-09-29. rfc7854_wire_header_test.go::TestRFC7854PeerASIsFourOctetsWithTheShortASZeroPadded writes a Peer Down (writePeerHeader) into a patterned buffer and reads per-peer octets 26-29 raw: 65001 must be 00 00 FD E9 (the 16 most significant bits zero) and 4200000001 must be FA 56 EA 01, so a 2-octet field, a lost padding or a misplaced AS goes red. {single-polarity: positive} holds: the field is a fixed 4-octet encode with no shorter variant to refuse.
